# P9-3.3 — one provisional resource write and exact charge admission

P9-3.3 implements the common resource boundary inside a complete step. User
review is pending. Entry follows the explicit P9-3.2 acceptance at `77286b2`,
preserved in [the separate acceptance record](./P9-3.2-AcceptanceRecord.json).
Historical P9-3.2 reviews and published evidence retain their original bytes.
P9-3.4 remains held; generic and specialization runtime support remain empty.

## Contract and evidence index

The numerical/regression run passes **1,632 tests with no failures, errors or
skips**, including 28 new test methods and eight clean installed environments.
Ruff, strict mypy on the four changed source/test files and `pip check` pass.
The [execution record](./P9-3.3-ExecutionRecord.json) links the retained runs.
The [validation manifest](../evidence/P9-3.3/validation/run.json) captures the
commands, environment, source subject, results and six successor forensic
queries alongside execution. This review is the leaf's claim-to-check index.

| Contract and source | Implementation | Challenge and limitation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Spec resource/charge sections; paper §§4.2–4.6, E.1–E.4; `D10.2-EC-PARENT-CORE-GENERAL-CHARGE` | `unit_charge`, `ChargeEvaluation` in `grc_v4_transport.py` | `ChargeTests`: literal round-to-even ties, odd/empty trees, 160 seeded scale trees against a separately padded recursive rational-node oracle; canonical input order matters at precision limits. |
| Spec `stable_pairwise_binary64_charge_v1` and charge inequality; frozen interface `ChargeReceipt` | Named unit charge/measure checks, adjacent tree, exact inequality, computed receipt fields | Inclusive absolute/relative boundaries and adjacent floats; rounded-product counterexample; overflowing thresholds/residuals; negative finite target remains schema-legal; aliases fail closed. No resource correction or remainder. |
| Paper continuity; `D10.2-EC-PARENT-CORE-INCIDENCE-CONTINUITY` | `provisional_continuity` uses the admitted graph differential | `ContinuityTests`: literal parallel/reversed edges, loop and isolate; 100 exact dyadic multigraph scatter oracles; all 48 small signed coordinate actions. Negative provisional C is exposed only to the admission gate. No external exchange is invented. |
| Spec complete-step order; `D10.2-EC-PARENT-L-AUTHORITATIVE-CURRENT`, `D10.2-EC-PARENT-L-CONTINUITY-WRITE` | `CurrentSelection`, `ProvisionalResourceStep` in `grc_v4_step.py` | `ResourceBoundaryTests`: all six failed solver dispositions with/without fallback flux reject before continuity; all ten declaration combinations consume one supplied current once. These are local boundary fixtures, not executed candidate/root solves. |
| `D10.2-EC-CHARGE-BUDGET-STAGE`, `D10.2-EC-PARENT-L-POSTCONTINUITY-REFRESH` | Prestate/reset charge checks, provisional continuity, nonnegative/finite/charge gate, then return C with old nonresource authority | Prestate/reset mismatch, overflow, negative result and a conservative exact transfer whose binary64 charge changes by 2. Writers and final reconstruction are absent from this boundary and cannot run on its rejected result. Actual commit/rollback remains later-owned. |
| Accepted stage/cache identities and spec realization order | Full independently supplied pre-read inputs and selected-stage result are compared | Wrong operation/duration/time/index/current/reset/target/ledger/reference/stage; OS predictor substitution; CI/CIPC trial-current substitution; lawful corrected Hodge allowed; stale final consumer rejects even when values coincide. |
| Spec zero-duration identity and no hidden lifecycle state | Zero duration checks local current/reset charge, selects no current and evaluates no continuity | All five realization declarations retain C/W_A/Z_4. Full zero-duration graph/profile/candidate/lifecycle admission remains with the complete-step owner. |
| Reconstructibility and installed consumption | Full input payloads; constructor recomputes output; existing V4 codec and declared extra | `ResourceReconstructionTests`: three independent hash seeds outside checkout; clean wheel and source-distribution installations under isolated imports; installed source hashes and package dependency checks. These checks do not establish every Python/OS combination. |

The frozen sources are [generic spec](../../../specs/grc-v4-spec.md),
[interface](../../../specs/grc-common-interface-v4-ext.md), and
[paper](../../investigations/grc9v4-constitutive-design/drafts/2026-09-GRC-V4.md).
The runner uses `load_successor_forensic_context`, which reconstructs the
accepted ET-C10 successor before `contract_provenance`. All six selected D10.2
contracts retain **`indeterminate_requires_review`**. Their query, trace digest,
source record/pointer and support disposition are retained; the committed tool
and investigation data reconstruct the full traces. These queries supply source
meaning, not new claim promotion or numerical conformance.

## Arithmetic and stage boundary

The shipped charge evaluator requires `unit_vertex_measure_v1` in both the
profile charge identity and common measure declaration. It consumes a typed
vertex scalar in the graph's declared live-vertex order. Adjacent pairs add in
binary64, carrying an unmatched last value unchanged to the next level. Every
addition rounds separately; no sorting, compensated sum or global exact sum
replaces the prescribed reduction. Empty primitive charge is zero; this does
not admit an empty full reference domain.

After obtaining that binary64 `Q_actual`, admission compares
`abs(Q_actual - Q_target) <= absolute_tolerance + relative_tolerance * max(abs(Q_target), 1)`
exactly on the represented binary64 inputs using rational arithmetic. Only the
signed diagnostic residual is rounded once for the frozen receipt/observable
fields. This makes the written inclusive inequality decisive even when a
binary64 tolerance product would round upward or overflow. The receipt fields
are `target_charge`, `admitted_charge` and `residual`; the actual lifecycle
owner must supply `ReceiptCore`. An unrepresentable residual rejects as
nonfinite. A finite negative target is not independently forbidden by the
frozen schema; the declared tolerance still decides admission.

A positive-duration boundary first checks current and reset charges against
the common target. It then checks a typed selected result against independently
captured pre-read scientific/lifecycle contents, full reference, context,
operation and duration. The required selected stages are OS corrector, CI
trial, PC old history, CI+PC trial and RG2b section. CI and CI+PC require the
selected current to equal the current bound to that trial. A corrected OS Hodge
may differ from the pre-read Hodge while retaining the full same reference and
operation authority. A supplied `valid_root` label is not a root certificate;
the later stage provider owns residual, domain, branch and stratum truth.

Only that validated current reaches `C - dt * B J` once. The accepted
differential computes divergence; each resource coordinate then performs one
binary64 multiplication and subtraction. Result finiteness, nonnegativity and
charge precede exposure to a final-C consumer. Admission never alters the
candidate C. The returned immutable provisional state retains the old W_A and
Z_4. Reset data, time/index, receipt ledger and authoritative lifecycle are
not mutated. `ResourceBoundaryError` carries local stage/code and, for a
finite charge mismatch, the computed evaluation; it is not a complete failure
receipt or evidence of rollback of a live mutable model.

Current-selection serialization is a closed implementation-local envelope,
not a new frozen schema. Replay reads full inputs and recomputes the result;
supplied cached outputs are not accepted. `consume` requires independent exact
prestate and selection expectations before exposing the provisional state.
Like the existing local geometry cache, this is immutable in-process content
binding, not authentication against hostile Python memory modification.

## Precision witnesses and remaining owners

The literal four-vertex case starts with `(2**53, 1, 1, 1)` and target
`2**53 + 2`. A unit transfer from the first to the last vertex yields exactly
`(2**53 - 1, 1, 1, 2)`. Real charge is conserved, but the prescribed tree now
returns `2**53 + 4`. Zero tolerance rejects with residual 2; absolute tolerance
2 accepts the unchanged candidate. This separates continuity's arithmetic
from charge admission and guards against hidden repair or silent tolerance.

For the rounded-tolerance witness, target 3 and its next larger binary64 value
have separation `2**-51`. With relative tolerance
`0x1.5555555555555p-53`, a binary64 multiplication by 3 rounds to that separation,
but the exact product is smaller. The gate rejects; the next larger tolerance
accepts. The independent oracle uses exact fractions, not the production gate.

The 48 covariance cases deliberately use exactly representable scales.
Canonical-order charge reduction and the accepted differential's native sum
are not a theorem of bitwise permutation invariance at arbitrary scales or
across Python summation implementations. Underflow may round a transfer away;
there is no hidden accumulated remainder. P9-3.4 owns broader conditioning,
signed/permutation and charge-precision characterization, including repeated
clusters/invariant projectors and the already retained mixed-scale star witness
`(5e-324, 1e150)`. This leaf neither changes that star arithmetic nor closes its
open finding.

P9-3.5 owns full rejected-operation preservation. Tranche 4 owns the actual C
current/OS provider and facade/complete-step admission and consumption;
Tranche 5 owns A_OS. Tranche 6 owns actual CI/PC/CI+PC/RG2b roots, invariant
carrier domains and their writer relationships. Full final-C reconstruction,
history writes, clock progression and atomic commit remain with those step
and lifecycle owners; P9-7.6 retains receipt lineage. Local tests across ten
declarations confer no executable generic or specialization profile support.

## Reconstruction and evidence workflow

From a checkout containing the implementation, provision the declared
`.[v4,dev]` extra plus `build setuptools wheel` in `.venv`. Use the side-tool
bootstrap for its managed browser environment as described in the handoff.
The numerical capture records the actual Python/platform and installed
dependencies. A compatible environment on another machine constitutes a new
run; no copied virtual environment or temporary directory is required.

A minimal replay can be extracted and run from the repository root:

```bash
.venv/bin/python -c 'import json,pathlib; p=pathlib.Path("implementation/phase-9-grcv4/evidence/P9-3.3/validation/inputs.json"); pathlib.Path("/tmp/p933-resource-input.json").write_text(json.dumps(json.loads(p.read_text())["resource_replay"]))'
.venv/bin/python -m tests.models.test_grc_v4_step --reconstruct-resource /tmp/p933-resource-input.json
```

For a fresh complete numerical/regression capture, prepare a compatible offline
wheelhouse and choose a **new** output directory:

```bash
GRCV4_PACKAGE_TESTS=1 GRCV4_WHEELHOUSE=/path/to/wheelhouse .venv/bin/python -m tests.models.test_grc_v4_step --capture-p933 /tmp/p933-new-run
```

`pip download '.[v4,dev]' build setuptools wheel --dest /path/to/wheelhouse`
can provision dependency archives on a machine with index access. The build
backend's requirements must also be available. Archive/platform differences
are a new package validation scope, not proof of byte-identical built archives.

The numerical run's `inputs.json` contains the Git base revision, a patch for
its relevant tracked source scopes, all scoped file hashes and the full replay
input. Retrieve the base with complete history and apply that patch to recover
the uncommitted execution subject; a digest alone is not a reconstruction.
The result is in `actual.json`. The tests are the runnable reproducers; there
are no copied scripts or repeated source snapshots per test. Routine fixture
and typing corrections are summarized here rather than retained as archives.

permits P9-3.3 on the existing transport/step source and test pairs. The coarse
source crosswalk omitted P9-3.3 on the step group; the adapter narrowly carries
the frozen checklist's explicit step-boundary ownership onto those existing
paths. Nine leaves become dependency-ready; the eligible path count remains
23. No later leaf is accepted by completion or manifest contents.
